look_here_first: OPEN masses of WHITE flowers on a climbing vine? Check the leafy stem and flower cluster. Sweet autumn clematis has MANY small white mostly BISEXUAL blooms in branching sprays, and opposite compound leaves with usually 3–5 oval, mostly smooth-edged ENTIRE leaflets. Native C. drummondii has often deeply cut/lobed leaflets and male/female flowers on SEPARATE plants. Both have feathery seedheads: fluff alone cannot distinguish them. This is INTRODUCED in Texas; learner look-alike only.

project_inclusion.range_basis: Introduced in Texas per POWO and FNA; no target-zone counties count as native.

best_field_traits: branched many-flowered clusters of small open four-sepaled flowers

comparisons.key_distinctions: C. drummondii has more deeply divided leaves, separate male/female plants and long plumose fruits. Native leatherflowers C. pitcheri and C. texensis have thick nodding urn flowers.
